user.title: Set up Bindplane
user.description: Home Assistant will install and start the **Bindplane Collector** add-on, then connect it to Bindplane.

advanced.name: Advanced: use my own collector
advanced.description: Already run a collector somewhere else? Enter its OTLP/HTTP URL and the add-on won't be installed.

hassio_confirm.title: Bindplane Collector found
hassio_confirm.description: The Bindplane Collector add-on is running. Set it up to send Home Assistant logs to Bindplane?

api_key.title: Connect to Bindplane
api_key.description:
Create an API key in Bindplane under **Project Settings → API Keys**.

A scoped key (starts with `bps_`) needs these permissions:
- **Secrets**: Read-only
- **Configurations**: Read and write
- **Collectors**: Read-only
- **Resources**: Read and write
- **Rollouts**: Read and write

Write access is only used to create the home-assistant configuration. A classic key works if your Bindplane user can edit configurations.

data_description.api_url: Bindplane Cloud is {cloud_url}. Use your own URL for self-hosted Bindplane.
data_description.project_id: Only needed for scoped API keys (starting with bps_).

configuration.title: Choose a configuration
configuration.description: Bindplane configurations decide where the collector sends data. Creating **{configuration}** adds an OpenTelemetry (OTLP) source that receives from Home Assistant and sends to the destinations you pick. You can change it later in Bindplane. Pick **Use a different API key** to go back.

data_description.destinations: Only used when creating the configuration. Leave empty to start with a home-assistant-dev-null destination that discards data, then swap in a real destination in Bindplane.

external.title: External collector
external.description: The collector needs an OpenTelemetry (OTLP) source listening on HTTP.

progress.install_addon: Installing the Bindplane Collector add-on. This can take a few minutes.

error.invalid_auth: Bindplane rejected the API key. Scoped keys (bps_) also need the project ID, and the key must have access to that project. ({error})
error.apply_failed: Bindplane could not create the configuration: {error}
error.missing_permission: The API key is missing a permission: {error}. Create a key with the permissions listed above.

abort.already_configured: This collector is already set up.
abort.addon_not_found: Could not find the Bindplane Collector add-on in the add-on store.
abort.addon_failed: The Bindplane Collector add-on failed to install or start. Check the Supervisor logs.
abort.addon_set_config_failed: Could not save the Bindplane Collector add-on options.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Reconfigured. The collector is reconnecting to Bindplane.

data_description.level: Home Assistant only logs WARNING and above by default. Picking a lower level here makes Home Assistant produce those records for Bindplane without making its own log noisier. Per-integration levels from the logger: config still apply.
data_description.exclude_loggers: Logger name prefixes to skip, e.g. homeassistant.components.recorder
data_description.events: Event types sent as log records. All events skips state_changed unless you also pick it; entity states are already exported as metrics.
data_description.metrics: Every minute: every entity's state, numeric attributes, availability and change count, plus CPU, memory, network and disk for Home Assistant, Supervisor and each add-on.
data_description.traces: Send every automation and script run as an OpenTelemetry trace, with a span per trigger, condition and action.
data_description.supervisor_logs: Follow the logs of every running add-on, the Supervisor and the host OS through the Supervisor API. Home Assistant OS and Supervised only.

flush.name: Flush
flush.description: Send buffered log records to the collector now.

send_test.name: Send test record
send_test.description: Emit a test log record so you can find it in your destination.
